"'''Justice'''" is the second episode of the anthology animated television series [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (television series)|''Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi'']]. The episode was directed by [[Saul Ruiz]], written by [[Dave Filoni]], and aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].

==Official description==
''Two Jedi are dispatched to resolve a hostage situation on a distant planet.''

==Plot summary==
===The rescue mission===
[[Jedi Master]] [[Dooku]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Qui-Gon Jinn]], arrive at a [[Wayyl|planet]] in [[shuttle]]. They land outside a dilapidated [[Wayyl village|village]], with its residents slamming doors and closing windows at their arrival, unfriendly towards outsiders. Eventually, the two find a [[cantina]] and enter. Dooku has a question for those inside: where is the [[Senator]]'s [[Uriel Dagonet|son]]?

An [[Unidentified village elder|older woman]] offers to speak. The son of [[Dagonet]], the planet's representative in the [[Galactic Senate]], has been kidnapped, and the [[Jedi]] have been sent to [[Mission to rescue Dagonet's son|rescue]] him. Dooku quickly realizes, however, that all of the villagers appear to be complicit in the abduction. The village elder admits to the crime, pointing out that Dagonet's long service to the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] has done everything to enrich him at the expense of his people.

===The skirmish===
She takes Dooku and Jinn to the barn where the son is being held. He says he's been treated well, and sympathizes with the plight of the people, saying he didn't know anything beforehand as he was usually on [[Coruscant]] or in the planet's [[Unidentified capital|capital]]. The discussion is interrupted by word that Dagonet has come in person, with [[soldier]]s. The elder accuses the Jedi of tricking her, but Dooku says that they came without the Senator's knowledge.

The villagers arm themselves, and they leave the barn with the Jedi. Dooku attempts to get Dagonet to stand down, noting that his people are angry with him for good reason. The Senator refuses, and a firefight breaks out. The Jedi defend the villagers, but several are still struck down. As the [[death]]s mount, Dooku takes a rash action and [[Force choke]]s the Senator, throwing Jinn away with [[the Force]] when he tries to stop him. Jinn goes back into the barn and frees Dagonet's son from his [[Stuncuffs|binders]], telling him to go out there and save his father.

===Justice and mercy===
The son's intervention leads Dooku to release the Senator, as the son expresses disappointment in his father. At the village, as father and son prepare to leave, Dagonet's son solemnly promises the village elder that he will help her people.

As the Senator and his son depart, Dooku wonders if lasting change will come from this. When Qui-Gon questions if that is why he took matters into his own hands, Dooku instead compliments him on his actions, as they saved many lives that day. Dooku tells Jinn that he acted wiser than his master on that day, and that he will be a great Jedi.
